description: Leaderboard competition design. Strategies compete; top performers earn rewards. Competition opens only for strategies that passed validation gates (G-0..G-8 as applicable). The current standings table is EMPTY on purpose - no strategy has entered, and fabricating results is forbidden.

phases.goal: forward picks tracked with zero risk

scoring.primary: deflated Sharpe ratio (dSR) over settled picks - designed to strip luck and strategy-count inflation
secondary: Brier score / log loss on probability forecasts

rewards.structure: TBD by owner (Q-01): points-only vs funded prizes

default_proposal.split: 50% season champion / 30% runner-up / 20% best CLV (consistent execution)
default_proposal.anti_gaming: rewards forfeited if picks are edited after kickoff or timestamps falsified

rules.rule: Picks must be timestamped before kickoff; no retro edits (G-1).
Minimum 5 picks/week to stay active in P2; absence weeks score neutral.
Stake sizing must follow the pre-registered rule; mid-season stake changes void that week.
Parlay entries must list every leg pair correlation value used (G-8).
Disqualification for fabricated sources; G-0 violations are permanent.
One strategy = one entry. Parameter variants must be separate pre-registered entries (counts against dSR deflation).
